title: Existence of a valid norm with sublinear type-2 growth
statement:
Let $X$ be a norm on the algebraic tensor product $\mathcal{S}_1^{\tilde k'\!, n}\otimes\mathcal{S}_1^{\tilde k'\!, n}\otimes\ell_2^{k\tilde k'}$. Call $X$ **valid** if

$$
\|x\|_X\gtrsim\|x\|_{X^{iii}}
$$

for every $x$, and

$$
\left\|\lvert i\rangle\otimes\lvert j\rangle\otimes\left(V\lvert ij\rangle\otimes\operatorname{Id}_{\ell_2^{\tilde k'}}\right)\right\|_X\leq 1
$$

for every $V\in B_{M_{n^2k,\tilde k'}}$ and $i,j=1,\ldots,n$. **Valid-norm conjecture.** There exists a valid norm $X$ and a dimension-independent constant $\beta<1$ such that

$$
\mathrm{T}_2^{(n^2)}(X)\lesssim_{\log}n^\beta.
$$

Any such norm would yield the type-2 estimate required by the preceding argument and hence the intended cryptographic lower bounds. The source presents this as an even weaker conjectural form and supplies no resolution.
source_name: Marius Junge, Aleksander M. Kubicki, Carlos Palazuelos and David Pérez-García, “Geometry of Banach spaces: a new route towards Position Based Cryptography”, arXiv:2103.16357 (2022).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.16357

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of March 2021).
